name: jsxmotion
description: Narrated videos written like apps: JSX scenes in Remotion, voiced by ElevenLabs, every frame on the spoken word. App guides, storyboard announcements and promos.

elevenlabs_api_key.title: ElevenLabs API key
elevenlabs_api_key.description: Paste or type your ElevenLabs API key here. It records the voiceover and is kept in your system keychain.

voice_id.title: ElevenLabs voice ID
voice_id.description: Optional. Paste a voice ID for your narrator here, or leave it empty and Claude finds a voice for you.

voices.title: More voices (for dialogue)
voices.description: Optional, for skits. Type each character's voice here as NAME=voice ID, separated by commas, like HOST=abc123, GUEST=def456.
